# Quite Apps

> Free Chrome extensions from an independent UK studio. Remove YouTube ads, clear your Facebook and Instagram feeds, and see what sites store on you.

We are a small independent studio in the UK. We make Chrome extensions that take things away rather than add them. Each one does a single job and then gets out of the way.

## Extensions

- [Quite for YouTube](https://quiteapps.co.uk/extensions/quite-for-youtube/): Skips video ads and hides the ad panels in your feed, sidebar, search results and Shorts, without tripping YouTube's anti-adblock check. Free, MIT licensed. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/quite-for-youtube/ibfocboidmabkdgnencnlbloigohcgci. Source: https://github.com/KingDogma23/quite-for-youtube
  - Permissions: storage, *://*.youtube.com/*
  - Version 0.32.4, updated 1 September 2026. Runs on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi.
- [Quite for Facebook](https://quiteapps.co.uk/extensions/quite-for-facebook/): Takes ads, suggested posts, suggested groups and the Sponsored column out of your feed, and leaves your friends' posts exactly where they were. Free, MIT licensed. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/quite-for-facebook/mmkkijoeabmdogijjnkglkmeckhdhedl. Source: https://github.com/KingDogma23/quite-for-facebook
  - Permissions: storage, *://*.facebook.com/*
  - Version 2.6.6, updated 1 September 2026. Runs on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi.
- [Quite for Instagram](https://quiteapps.co.uk/extensions/quite-for-instagram/): Hides adverts and the suggested posts pushed at you from accounts you do not follow, and does nothing else. What is left is the people you chose. Free, MIT licensed. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/quite-for-instagram/mlnienohcfmeaankmfbclaikelngmbjk. Not yet released.
  - Permissions: storage, *://*.instagram.com/*
  - Version 0.1.24, updated 3 September 2026. Runs on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi.
- [Quite for Cookies](https://quiteapps.co.uk/extensions/quite-for-cookies/): Shows exactly what a site has stored in your browser, deletes only what you pick, then counts again and tells you what actually went. It can also clear a site on its own when you close its last tab. Free, MIT licensed. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/quite-for-cookies/iagkmeadnfkmgocminiglpibkcnibnch. Source: https://github.com/KingDogma23/quite-for-cookies
  - Permissions: activeTab, cookies, browsingData, scripting, storage, None at install
  - Version 0.23.2, updated 10 September 2026. Runs on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi.

## How the extensions are distributed

All of them install from the Chrome Web Store. The full source of
Quite for YouTube, Quite for Facebook and Quite for Cookies is public on GitHub
at https://github.com/KingDogma23.

## Privacy

- [Privacy](https://quiteapps.co.uk/privacy/): No analytics, no cookies, no accounts, no servers.
  Each extension runs only on the single site it is for and stores nothing beyond
  your own settings, in your own browser.
